title: Topic 6
japanese_text: <u>英雄</u>の条件にはいろいろあるが、必ずしも力の強さだけが条件ではない。自分が<u>敵わない</u>ような<u>悪者</u>にも<u>勇敢に</u>立ち向かう。そんな精神的な強さが条件ではないだろうか。
english_translation: There are many requirements for a hero, and strength is not necessarily the only one. Heroism also means bravely standing up to villains whom the hero is no match for. This strength of spirit is also a requirement.
